LOW_SPO2.action: Verify sensor reading and request clinician review

HIGH_HR.action: Monitor persistence and seek clinical assessment

LOW_BP.observation: Blood pressure is below the configured observation threshold
LOW_BP.action: Repeat the measurement, assess for symptoms, and request clinician review

HIGH_TEMP.observation: Temperature is above the configured observation threshold
HIGH_TEMP.action: Repeat the measurement, review symptoms, and seek clinical assessment if persistent

LOW_GLUCOSE.observation: Blood glucose is below the configured observation threshold
LOW_GLUCOSE.action: Verify the measurement and follow the applicable clinical protocol or request urgent clinician guidance

HIGH_RESP_RATE.observation: Respiratory rate is above the configured observation threshold
HIGH_RESP_RATE.action: Repeat the measurement, assess the patient promptly, and request clinician review

LOW_HR.observation: Heart rate is below the configured observation threshold
LOW_HR.action: Verify the reading, assess for symptoms, and request clinical assessment

HIGH_BP.observation: Blood pressure is above the configured observation threshold
HIGH_BP.action: Repeat the measurement using correct technique and request clinician review, especially if symptoms are present
